description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PortPlumbing' for managing per-port traffic separation configurations in a networking context within the 'beerocks::net' namespace. It includes virtual methods for applying and clearing configurations, meant to be overridden by derived classes.

classes.name: PortPlumbing
classes.description: Abstract base class for per-port plumbing configurations, providing interface methods for applying and clearing traffic separation settings.

methods.name: ~PortPlumbing
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the PortPlumbing interface.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Pure virtual method to apply traffic separation configuration for a port.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Pure virtual method to rollback or clear the last applied configuration.
